description: Source code for the ParquetColumnVector class in Apache Spark, representing a Parquet column with support for nested and primitive types, including assembly and reset operations.

classes.name: ParquetColumnVector
classes.description: Represents a vectorized view of a Parquet column, supporting nested structures, assembly, and reset operations.

methods.name: ParquetColumnVector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ParquetColumnVector with schema, vectors, and default values.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child column vectors.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns all leaf column vectors in depth-first order.

methods.name: assemble
methods.description: Assembles the column data, handling nested and variant types.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the vector and its children to prepare for new data.

methods.name: getValueVector
methods.description: Returns the vector storing actual values.

methods.name: getRepetitionLevelVector
methods.description: Returns the vector storing repetition levels.

methods.name: getDefinitionLevelVector
methods.description: Returns the vector storing definition levels.

methods.name: getColumnReader
methods.description: Returns the column reader for reading data.

methods.name: setColumnReader
methods.description: Sets the column reader; only applicable for primitive columns.
